response.what_it_is: Used blue plastic 200-litre drums/barrels stacked in a warehouse
hidden_risks: internal chemical residue or strong odors from previous contents
undetected hairline cracks or structural weakness
degradation of plastic integrity from previous sun exposure
response.best_proof: A close-up photograph of the interior and the bung/lid area of an opened drum
response.failure_mode: Mistaking the stacked storage lot for industrial manufacturer inventory or misjudging internal cleanliness and leakage potential from exterior-only photos.
